result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days. It was printing `loc180Days` next to the 90-day count and percentage.

The fix is one word in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportOverviewSection.java`, in `addBigRepositoriesSummary`: `loc180Days` became `loc90Days`. The `loc90Days` value was already computed and used for the percentage.

The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add a new one.
